   Sports Lakers vs. Warriors Injury Report – Oct. 30
 Oct 30, 2026 Photo : Stacy Revere / Getty Images Sport / Getty Images 
 The injury report for the Los Angeles Lakers (4-1) ahead of their game against the Golden State Warriors (2-3) currently includes three players. The Warriors have four injured players listed on the report. The matchup is scheduled for 10 p.m. ET on Friday, Oct. 30.

 Lakers Stats
 Los Angeles is outscoring opponents by 9.6 points per game with a +48 scoring differential overall. It puts up 123.2 points per game (first in the NBA) and allows 113.6 per outing (14th in the league).
 Luka Doncic leads the Lakers, putting up 36 points per game (first in the NBA).
 Los Angeles loses the rebound battle by an average of 2.2 boards. It is recording 38 rebounds per game (30th in the league) compared to its opponents' 40.2 per outing.
 Walker Kessler's 8.2 rebounds per game lead the Lakers and rank 24th in league play.
 Los Angeles connects on 1.8 more threes per contest than the opposition, 14.2 (eighth-most in the league) compared to its opponents' 12.4.
 The Lakers are paced by Doncic's 5.3 threes per game (first in the league).

 Warriors Stats
 Golden State is being outscored by 1.8 points per game, with a -9 scoring differential overall. It puts up 117.6 points per game (10th in NBA), and allows 119.4 per outing (21st in league).
 Stephen Curry is third in the league with a team-high 28.8 points per game.
 The 43.8 rebounds per game Golden State accumulates rank 19th in the league, 2.6 more than the 41.2 its opponents grab.
 Yaxel Lendeborg paces the Warriors with 9.2 rebounds per game (12th in league).
 Golden State makes 14.4 three-pointers per game (seventh-most in the league) while shooting 36.9% from beyond the arc (eighth-best in NBA). It is making 1.4 more threes than its opponents, who drain 13 per game at 36.5%.
 The Warriors are paced by Curry's 3.5 threes per game (eighth in league).
